owner_rule: t117u 2026-10-23: show anims must never bleed into the moveset during play; crossover only where explicitly allowed.

fight_to_show.note: Fight clips (by T3 action name) that may be reused outside FIGHT. Read-only reuse; the fight clip is never edited.

show_to_fight.note: Show clips (anims/show/<char>/<slot>) may enter ONLY these contexts. FIGHT is never allowed here; adding a show clip to FIGHT requires an owner-approved moveset PR (the clip then becomes a moveset clip, not a show clip).
